final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim to a more policy-bounded interpretation of the same summarized record. That reinterpretation matters substantively: it rejects a clean pass, rejects reliance on the unapproved mitigation, and correctly distinguishes caveated certification from minor-caveat framing. But this is still not enough to move to compliant_with_caveats on the evidence available to this role. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if the material weakness is disclosed or an approved mitigation removes exposure. The Actor now expressly concedes that, absent explicit material disclosure in the certification materials, certification would not be compliant. Since no actual disclosure text, certification artifact, or approval-status record is available here, the core compliance predicate remains unproven. The Actor's response therefore improves the legal and policy framing but does not cure the original evidentiary gap. The appropriate final assessment remains suspicious rather than noncompliant, because the narrowed position could be compliant if the missing disclosure predicate is in fact satisfied; however, that fact is still not established on this admissible record.
